claim_boundary: Exact fixed-ray complete-to-primitive L2 transfer, local difference sampling reduction, elementary norm-collapsed companion, and sharp fibrewise/difference-energy containment only. No selected primitive Guth--Maynard-shaped cubic estimate, Hecke large-value theorem, density theorem, detector, or prime-ideal theorem is proved.

complete_to_primitive_transfer.derivative: The same bound for F_eta' has an additional log^2(2N), since the common coefficient is u_f(a)log Na.

finite_zero_extension_check.conclusion: The exact reindexing requires u_f=u*1_(a,f)=1; retaining u would change the polynomial.
finite_zero_extension_check.formal_modulus: f=pq with primitive ancestor d=p dividing f

complete_to_primitive_transfer.loss_accounting: No tau(f), 2^omega(f), completion factor, signed primitive-projector triangle inequality, or altered zero extension enters this fixed-modulus L2 transfer.
complete_to_primitive_transfer.setup: Fix f, X=Cl(f)^, H=|X|, q=Nf, and u_f(a)=u(a)1_(a,f)=1. Every eta in X has one primitive exact conductor d_eta|f and primitive ancestor eta_star modulo d_eta.
complete_to_primitive_transfer.thorner_reindexing: The map eta -> (d_eta,eta_star) is injective into Thorner's primitive m=0 family with Nd_eta<=q. Enlarge this nonnegative subcollection to all primitive conductors <=q before applying Theorem 2.1 with ideal cutoff 2N and height B.
complete_to_primitive_transfer.zero_extension_reason: On (a,f)=1 the two character values agree. On the complement u_f vanishes, which exactly reproduces eta modulo f without inflating eta_star.

difference_energy_boundary.coloured_energy_boundary: The preceding P7 coloured energy has a character-product equation and does not bound this uncoloured difference statistic under the frozen hypotheses.

finite_exact_check.asymptotic_sampling_loss: E_diff^(1/2)/D_Delta is asymptotic to a constant times m^(1/2).

difference_energy_boundary.progression_countercost: For T={0,...,m-1}, Delta=1/4, D_Delta=m but E_diff_(2Delta)=(2m^3+m)/3. Replacing D by E_diff^(1/2) costs m^(1/2) in delta_2^2 and m^(1/4) in the perturbative cubic error.
difference_energy_boundary.sharp_sampling_message: The L2-to-discrete transfer weights local continuous mass by an L-infinity difference multiplicity. Energy gives only its square-root upper bound unless a higher-moment/local-distribution input is added.

difference_sampling.definition: D_Delta(T)=sup_v #{(t,s) in T^2: |t-s-v|<=Delta}, with 0<Delta<1/2 and T=pi_t W subset [0,T_height].
difference_sampling.exact_reduction: Summing local Sobolev over t-s and using D_Delta yields delta_2^2 <= H^-1 D_Delta times the complete-character continuous L2-plus-derivative mass.
difference_sampling.scope: This is a completion-free raw L2 discrepancy estimate, not the source-shaped selected cubic estimate.
difference_sampling.thorner_bound: delta_2^2 <<_K H^-1 D_Delta Gamma_Th(N,q,B,Delta)||u_f||_2^2, B=T_height+Delta, Gamma_Th=(Delta^-1+2Delta log^2(2N))(2N+q^2B^2)(log(qB))^A.

non_promotion: No selected primitive cubic estimate of Guth--Maynard source shape is proved.
No Hecke large-value, zero-density, detector, or prime-ideal interval theorem is proved.

norm_collapsed_companion.cancellation: The H from complete-character norm aggregation cancels the H^-1 in the exact discrepancy identity.
norm_collapsed_companion.complete_character_norm_bound: sum_eta sum_n|b_eta(n)|^2 <= H Delta_K(N)||u_f||_2^2, Delta_K(N)=max_{N<n<=2N}a_Q(i)(n)<=max tau(n).
norm_collapsed_companion.elementary_mean_value: integral_-B^B |sum b(n)n^(iv)|^2 dv << (B+N(1+log(2N)))sum|b(n)|^2, by expansion plus the harmonic-series Schur bound.
norm_collapsed_companion.non_promotion: This companion remains a raw L2/difference-sampling bound; it supplies neither a selected primitive cubic estimate nor an L-infinity large-value theorem.
norm_collapsed_companion.normalization_scope: If N<=T_height^C for fixed C, then Delta_K(N)=T_height^o(1) by the already pinned P7-1 divisor normalization.

per_character_separation.bound: If each exact-primitive-character fibre is 1-separated and P_f colours can occur, then D_Delta(T)<=|T|P_f for Delta<1/2; in particular D_Delta<=|T|H.

finite_exact_check.sharpness: All within-block differences lie in the radius-1/4 window about zero; no better bound follows from fibrewise separation alone.

per_character_separation.implication: Per-character separation permits a fixed-power cross-character clustering loss and cannot by itself make D_Delta subpower.
per_character_separation.reason: A length-2Delta interval contains at most one time from each fibre. For fixed t the admissible s values lie in one such interval.
per_character_separation.sharpness: The exact P-colour/J-block construction t_(j,c)=3j+c/(8P) realizes D_(1/4)=|T|P while every fibre is 3-separated.

scoped_no_go.minimal_missing_statistic: A source-scale local uncoloured difference-sampling bound D_Delta(T)<=D_target, with D_target set by the displayed cubic-budget gate, or a localized higher-moment/ray-class distribution theorem that bypasses this L2 sampling step.
scoped_no_go.non_overclaim: This does not rule out additional detector arithmetic, an ideal-class Poisson theorem, or a new higher-moment method. The finite sharpness constructions are not P7 detector or zero examples.
scoped_no_go.reason: Their strongest deterministic combination is the displayed D_Delta bounds. Fibrewise separation permits the sharp |T|P_f scale, and energy alone can lose an extra square-root multiplicity.
scoped_no_go.statement: Complete-to-primitive reindexing, Thorner L2, the elementary norm-collapsed L2 bound, per-character separation, and an unlocalized difference energy do not imply a Guth--Maynard-shaped selected cubic excess bound under the frozen P7 hypotheses.

selected_cubic_budget.additional_open_input: A source-shaped bound for the averaged block A_0 is separately required; the displayed D_Delta condition controls only the discrepancy perturbation.
selected_cubic_budget.budget_root: For target discrepancy budget B>0, define z_B(a_3,H)>0 by 3H^3 z_B(a_3+z_B)^2=B.
selected_cubic_budget.exponent_cost: If D_Delta=T^kappa relative to a subpower benchmark, delta_2 gains T^(kappa/2). The perturbative cubic term gains T^(kappa/2), while the delta-dominant cubic term gains T^(3kappa/2).

finite_exact_check.definition: z_B is the positive root of 3H^3 z(a_3+z)^2=B.
finite_exact_check.exponent_rule: If D_Delta gains T^kappa, then delta gains T^(kappa/2); the cubic perturbation gains T^(kappa/2) when delta<=a_3 and T^(3kappa/2) when delta>=a_3.

selected_cubic_budget.mean_value_difference_gate: The norm-collapsed route meets B if D_Delta is at most a constant times z_B^2/(Gamma_MV||u_f||_2^2).
selected_cubic_budget.thorner_difference_gate: The Thorner route meets B if D_Delta is at most a K-constant times H z_B^2/(Gamma_Th||u_f||_2^2).
